ex15.title: How to set up a passkey: never type a password again
ex15.reel_caption:
How to set up a passkey: never type a password again. 🔑

Passwords get phished and leaked. A passkey lives on your phone and only works on the real site, so a fake page gets nothing. Turn it on tonight in your Google or Apple account security settings.

📤 Send this to someone who reuses one password everywhere
📌 Save it for later

#passkeys #cybersecurity #passwordsecurity #onlinesafety
